added_findings.title: VV runs under the shared Whitecardopedia service worker: each wave needs Adam's token decision
added_findings.detail: Refutes F49. VV index.html:44 loads ../Whitecardopedia/02__Src__AppModules/62__Feature__AppInstallability/Whitecardopedia__Pwa__ServiceWorker__Registrar__.js. It registers the WebApps-root stub Na__Pwa__ServiceWorker__.js, which importScripts Whitecardopedia__Pwa__ServiceWorker__Logic__.js ('Caching brain of the Whitecardopedia + ValeVision3D PWA'). On VV's live https origin (adam-noble-01.github.io), shell JS/CSS is served stale-while-revalidate against PWA_SW_VERSION_TOKEN = '2026-09-18-1' (:229); on localhost it is network-first. The worker's own log records token bumps for VV Layout Editor releases (1.0.5 to 1.0.8) and a mixed old/new module graph failing to link ('does not provide an export named ...', 1.0.7). VV's ledger corrected its own 'n/a - this tree has no PWA worker' rows (:135-175), and VV devlog v2.67-v2.71 end with 'THE SHARED SERVICE WORKER' notes. This slice adds 31 modules, puts new exports on Measurements, SheetSurface, SheetModel, SheetModel__Layers and ShapeGeometry in the seam wave alone, and repoints 10 importers: exactly that failure. Bumping the token evicts every Vale app's caches, models included, so it is Adam's call, and the file is outside VV's tree. The worker's best-effort precache lists only VV start-up modules, none in 51__System__LayoutEditor, so deleting Snapping__.js cannot break its install.
added_findings.recommendation: No WP edits the Whitecardopedia worker. Every WP of this slice ends its VV devlog entry with a 'THE SHARED SERVICE WORKER' note naming the new modules and the new exports on existing modules. Ledger return-trip rows record 'Service worker token: shared Whitecardopedia worker - Adam's call', never 'n/a'. Raise one bump request with Adam per deployed wave (D-S04b-V01, WP-S04b-16).

added_findings.title: A Snapping__ shim must not re-export the controller (module cycle through Measurements)
added_findings.detail: The survey's shim (F02, WP-S04b-06, D-S04b-09) re-exports 'the new names from Search, Marker and the controller'. The controller imports Measurements for Say (ObjectSnap__.js:99), and VV Measurements__.js:118-120 imports ShapeTool, RectangleTool and DimensionTool, all of which import Snapping__.js. Routing Toggle/SetEnabled through the shim creates tools -> Snapping -> controller -> Measurements -> tools, the cycle TV's ObjectSnap__.js:33-37 exists to avoid ('a tool importing it would close a cycle'). VV Measurements calls the tools only inside function bodies, so it would probably not throw today, but it is a latent TDZ trap, and Na__Verify__ModuleGraph__.mjs checks resolution only, not cycles. Only Keyboard:123, Toolbar:110 and ContextMenu:100 import Toggle; no VV module imports SetEnabled, KIND_END or KIND_MID. TV State exports CHANGED_EVENT and IsEnabled; Search re-exports IsEnabled, Find, Snap, Clear, ShowMarker and HideMarker. Compatibility of the unchanged VV call sites was verified: Search.Snap ignores a string 4th argument (:506-512), ShowMarker(hit) ignores a 2nd, Marker.TargetOf (:141-146) colours tone-less hits (infer -> dimension, else -> shape), and TV's exclusion shapes are VV's (Sources:414-457).
added_findings.recommendation: The shim imports only from __Search__ (Find, Snap, ShowMarker, HideMarker, Clear, IsEnabled, KIND_END, KIND_MID) and __State__ (CHANGED_EVENT), with TONE_VERTEX/DIMENSION/VIEWPORT as local strings. In the same commit, repoint Keyboard:123, Toolbar:110 and ContextMenu:100 to ../28__System__ObjectSnap/Na__LayoutEditor__ObjectSnap__.js and ModeController:228 to __Search__ (WP-S04b-06R). Acceptance: grep shows no import of Na__LayoutEditor__ObjectSnap__.js from the shim or from 35__System__DrawingTools.

Each VV devlog entry of this slice ends with a 'THE SHARED SERVICE WORKER' note in VV's own form (VV devlog v2.67-v2.71). acceptance: Every VV devlog entry written by this slice carries the note
No file outside D:\10_CoreLib__ValeCodebase\WebApps\ValeVision3D is modified
Adam has answered D-S04b-V01 before any wave is deployed to the live origin
added_work_packages.risk: Low to write. The risk it manages is high: a warm client holding old and new modules fails to link the editor.

added_decisions.question: ValeVision3D is served by the SHARED Whitecardopedia + ValeVision3D service worker (PWA_SW_VERSION_TOKEN '2026-09-18-1', shell JS stale-while-revalidate away from localhost). This slice adds 31 modules and new exports on existing ones (five in the seam wave: Measurements, SheetSurface, SheetModel, SheetModel__Layers, ShapeGeometry). Should the shared token be bumped as these land?
added_decisions.options: (a) one bump per deployed wave of this slice; (b) one bump after the whole slice; (c) no bump, accepting that warm clients may fail to link the editor until a second visit
added_decisions.recommendation: Adam's call: the token evicts every Vale app's caches, models included (VV ledger :135-175). Recommend (a), because this is exactly the mixed-graph link failure the worker's own log records. Swarm agents never edit the worker; they write the devlog note (WP-S04b-16).

notes: The survey was strong. All 31 files are accounted for, and every one of the nine 'VV lacks' names was independently re-resolved and then searched for in VV under any name; none exists. All 43 hub-file version pairs, the devlog line references and nearly every path:line I sampled (about 130 claims) were exact. One finding is refuted: F49. VV is NOT without a service worker. It sits under the shared Whitecardopedia worker, the VV ledger already corrects this at :135-175, and several sibling slices get it right. Four gaps added. (1) The token decision is Adam's (S04b-V01, D-S04b-V01, WP-S04b-16). (2) The proposed Snapping__ shim must not re-export the controller, or it closes the tools -> controller -> Measurements -> tools cycle (S04b-V02; WP-06 replaced by 06R). (3) The ShapeGeometry seam must be a hunk: TV's whole 1.9.0 file imports NA's Project Portal QR (53) and Sheet Images (54) (S04b-V03). (4) The carry needs TV-only CarryTarget in HitResolution and treats missing config keys as 'off' (S04b-V04; WP-11 replaced by 11R). Minor corrections: VV Snapping 1.2.0 lacks TV 1.2.0's FindOnViewport; the marker counts are 20 of 21 JS files and 124 app-wide; F06's v2.111 file list was incomplete (MarginGrip and others; WP-02 replaced by 02R); DimensionTool also needs IsLayerSelectable; RedrawHeld must drop TOOL_AREA. Watch: (a) cross-slice ownership. S03b owns ShapeGeometry, SheetSurface and SheetModel and plans a whole-file ShapeGeometry port; S05b also ports Curves and ShapeRings; S05a's hub ports cannot link before these folders exist. The planning agent must serialise WP-02R/06R/09 against those slices. (b) The TV devlogs say Adam has not yet tried most of these aids in TV itself, so D-S04b-01 (sign-off) is real. (c) Nothing was executed: no Node suites and no in-app checks. The cycle risk was judged by reading VV Measurements, where every tool call is inside a function body, so it is latent rather than an immediate crash. Report edited in place, with a Verification section appended; a pre-verification copy is at scratchpad/parity/verify_s04b/S04b_report_before_verify.md.
